description: "The American Reformed Cattle Doctor" by George H. Dadd is a veterinary guide written in the mid-19th century. This book focuses on the health and treatment of farm animals, particularly cattle, sheep, and swine, providing guidance for farmers to diagnose and treat various diseases.
